governance_scope: Post-R7.5.3 V1+ architecture-reset evidence only; R7.5.3 remains FAIL_BLOCKED_CLOSED.
interpretation: Putting both already-diverged behavior ensembles on exactly the same 240 stored chance realizations materially reduces cross-behavior target-policy TV, from the Phase2B1 chance reference 0.51537 to 0.38892 in the primary independent-traversal arm.
The reduction is real but insufficient under the frozen gate: 24.54% relative is below the required 30%, and the resulting 0.38892 remains above the absolute <=0.35 requirement.
COMMON_TRAVERSAL_RNG and INDEPENDENT_TRAVERSAL_RNG are nearly identical (0.38709 versus 0.38892), reinforcing the Phase2B1 conclusion that traversal RNG is a minor component.
Therefore neither different finite chance support nor already-diverged behavior feedback alone explains the full instability; both contribute materially.
Do not start a shared-chance training pilot yet. The remaining feedback must be localized before modifying training.
next_gate: Localize the remaining same-chance behavior-feedback divergence into root traverser baseline-policy effects versus downstream continuation-policy effects before any training pilot.
